73:2.text: the night, except for a little -

73:3.text: Half of it - or subtract from it a little

73:4.text: Or add to it, and recite the Qur’ān with measured recitation.

73:5.text: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word.

73:6.text: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence

73:7.text: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation.

73:8.text: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with

73:9.text: the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of

73:10.text: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance.

73:11.text: , and allow them respite a little.

73:13.text: And food that chokes and a painful punishment -

73:14.text: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.

73:15.text: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.

73:16.text: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure.

73:17.text: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white-haired?

73:18.text: The heaven will break apart therefrom;

73:19.text: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way.
